companyDescription: Alzheimer's · Sabirnetug (ACU193), a monoclonal antibody that targets toxic soluble amyloid-beta oligomers rather than plaque. The 542-patient Phase 2 ALTITUDE-AD reads out Nov 2026; subcutaneous version with Halozyme; JCR brain-shuttle program
priceNote: Live $2.09 (+5.6%) at Oct 26, 2026 open, the day Q3 results reaffirmed November topline timing. 52-week range $1.50-$3.60. Market cap ~$151M on 72.3M shares; Sep 30 cash $78.6M is ~$1.09/share (~52% of price).
summary: ALTITUDE-AD — a 542-patient Phase 2 of the oligomer-selective antibody sabirnetug in early Alzheimer's — reads out in November 2026. This is the purest binary on the board. Success (~30% iADRS slowing, management's bar) would make ABOS a credible partner asset in a market where lecanemab and donanemab already validated the amyloid pathway. ⚠️ SURVIVAL: cash of $78.6M only funds operations into early 2027, and the company has an S-3 shelf/ATM in place. It earns a top-5 slot anyway because the readout lands before cash runs out, and ~52% of the market cap is cash. A positive result would likely be followed by a raise from strength, not distress. The phase3_readout bucket has n=1 in turbo feedback (context only). Base (+45%) exceeds the lane's realized 30-day P90 (+25.9%; written-Base bias +72.7pp). It assumes an 'encouraging but sub-30%' topline within ~1-3 months that re-tests the $3.03-3.60 zone. แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้าผลไม่ผ่าน ลงได้ 60-80%.

catalysts.name: ALTITUDE-AD Phase 2 topline (sabirnetug)
catalysts.description: 542-patient, placebo-controlled, every-4-week IV study in early Alzheimer's, testing two doses. Management calls ~30% slowing on iADRS a clear success threshold. Exact day not announced; company guides November 2026.

catalysts.name: Enhanced Brain Delivery IND (JCR partnership)
catalysts.description: Brain-shuttle version of the oligomer antibody. IND targeted mid-2027 — optionality only.

risks: ⚠️ SURVIVAL: Sep 30, 2026 cash $78.6M funds operations only 'into early 2027' (under 12 months) on ~$25M quarterly net loss, with an active S-3 shelf and ATM program. Any outcome is likely followed by a financing; after a miss it would be deeply dilutive.
True binary: the Athira precedent (-72% after hours, -81% in three days) is the realistic failure template, and cash/share (~$1.09) is only a partial floor once burn is counted.
Phase 2 primary endpoint risk: a statistically 'positive' but clinically modest effect (well under 30% iADRS slowing) could still sell off, as Compass Pathways did on a narrow Phase 3 win.

Commercial overhang: even on success, sabirnetug enters a market where Leqembi and Kisunla already exist and uptake has been slower than hoped. The partnering value depends on a clear safety/ARIA edge.
Exact topline date not disclosed ('November 2026'), so time-decay and pre-event dilution timing are both uncertain.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds at 3.75-4.00% after the surprise Sep 16, 2026 hike (first since 2023). The Oct 27-28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold / ~7% +25bp as of Oct 25 — but hike odds briefly spiked to ~44% after the hot Sep CPI print on Oct 14, so the path stays two-sided.
macroRisk.inflationNote: September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y headline; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — both above consensus. Headline re-acceleration keeps a further 2026 hike live.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: A sub-$200M, pre-revenue biotech with under 12 months of cash is maximally exposed to financing conditions. A hawkish surprise compresses the window to raise on good data and deepens the discount on any raise after bad data.
macroRisk.summary: HIGH — macro won't decide this binary, but it decides how expensive the next raise is either way. Oct 28 hold is priced; hot CPI keeps hikes alive.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · ค่าขนม 2% max — the purest Alzheimer's binary available (Nov 2026 topline), with a survival flag offset by ~52% of cap in cash. Measured turbo at-catalyst median is -13.7% (n=19), so Entry 2 ($1.75-1.90) is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only. Size it as an option premium you can lose entirely.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Alzheimer's small caps tend to drift up into readouts and then gap on the data. ABOS is +5.6% today and well off its $1.50 low, but still below its $3.60 high. Note: ALTITUDE-AD is a Phase 2, but at n=542 it is sized like a pivotal study, so it is bucketed with phase3_readout as the closest clinical-readout type.
catalystSpot.preRunupPct: Not measured — no clean sector average found

postWin.note: Average of two real Alzheimer's small-cap positive-data moves: Cassava (SAVA) +145% over Feb 2021 on simufilam cognition data, and Cognition Therapeutics (CGTX) +20.8% day-1 on its Jul 2025 Phase 2. The SAVA case was later tainted by data-integrity allegations, so treat it as the sentiment ceiling, not a base rate.

postLose.note: Athira (ATHA): LIFT-AD Alzheimer's failure on Sep 3, 2024 — -72% after hours, -81% over three sessions. This is the realistic gap-down template for a failed AD readout at a sub-$200M cap.

spotSizing.reason: 2% max. A pure binary with a survival flag. The phase3_readout bucket has n=1 in turbo feedback (context only, no tier-2 weight), and the lane-wide scoreboard is weak (hitRate 4.9%, softHit 22%, n=41), so sizing sits at the floor of the band.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the lane medianMAE (-24.1%). Pre-readout breaks below ~$1.50 usually mean a raise or a leak. A topline miss will gap through any stop, so position size is the real risk control.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If ALTITUDE-AD misses the primary endpoint, exit on day 1 — do not wait for a 'subgroup' story (the Athira pattern).

comparableCases.event: Simufilam Alzheimer's cognition data + end-of-Phase-2 FDA meeting
comparableCases.note: Upside template: a sub-$200M Alzheimer's name re-rated 2.5x in one month on positive cognition data. Caveat: Cassava's data later faced integrity allegations — the move shows what sentiment does, not what the science was worth.

Downside template: Alzheimer's readout miss at a small cap. -72% after hours, -81% over three days. ABOS's bear case (-65%) assumes cash/share (~$1.09) provides only a partial floor because of ongoing burn.
Middle case: encouraging but not decisive Phase 2 data gave only +20.8% day-1. A 'directional but not 30%' ALTITUDE-AD result likely lands here.

th.summary: ALTITUDE-AD — Phase 2 จำนวน 542 รายของ sabirnetug แอนติบอดีที่จับ amyloid-beta oligomer แบบเฉพาะ ในอัลไซเมอร์ระยะแรก — ประกาศผลเดือน พ.ย. 2026 เป็น binary ที่ชัดที่สุดบนกระดาน ถ้าสำเร็จ (ชะลอ iADRS ~30% ตามเกณฑ์ผู้บริหาร) ABOS จะเป็นสินทรัพย์ที่ยาใหญ่สนใจ ในตลาดที่ lecanemab และ donanemab พิสูจน์แนวทาง amyloid แล้ว ⚠️ SURVIVAL: เงินสด $78.6M พอถึงต้นปี 2027 เท่านั้น และมี S-3 shelf/ATM ที่ยังติด top 5 เพราะผลออกก่อนเงินหมด และ ~52% ของ market cap เป็นเงินสด ผลบวกน่าจะตามด้วยการเพิ่มทุนจากจุดแข็ง ไม่ใช่จนตรอก ประเภท phase3_readout มี n=1 ใน turbo feedback (ใช้เป็นบริบทเท่านั้น) Base (+45%) สูงกว่า P90 ที่เกิดจริง (+25.9%; bias +72.7pp) โดยสมมติผล 'ดีแต่ไม่ถึง 30%' ในกรอบ 1-3 เดือน แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้าผลไม่ผ่าน ลงได้ 60-80%
